senses.gloss:
--a sage; knows the योग power of Hari.
1: भा. II. 7. ४५.
Pleased by कुवलयाश्व killing Dhundhu.
2: Ib. IX. 6. २२.

(I)--a ब्रह्मऋषि residing on the Meru slopes; appealed to बृहदश्व of इक्ष्वाकु line to vanquish Dhundhu (son of Madhu) residing near his hermitage and causing trouble to his peaceful avocations: कुवलाश्व at the bidding of his father बृहदश्व killed the asura and earned the title धुन्धुमार. Br. III. 6. ३२; ६३. ३४-60; वा. ६८. ३१; ८८. ३३-60.
(II)--the Purohita of मान्धातृ, the emperor and fifth incarnation of विष्णु. M. ४७. २४३.

(I)--the son of अङ्गिरस and सुरूपा and father of two sons, Vicitta and शरद्वान्; of the स्वरोचिष epoch. An incarnation; a contemporary of मान्धातृ. भा. IV. 1. ३५; Br. II. ३२. ९९; III. 1. १०५; ७३. ९०; वा. ६५. १००, १०१.
(II)--a मरीचि god. Br. IV. 1. ५९.

(III) a ऋषि by तपस्; and a मन्त्रकृत्; a gotra- कार;
1: M. १४५. ९३, १०४; १९६. 4.
came to see परीक्षित् practising प्रायोपवेश।
2: भा. I. १९. 9.

(IV)--a son of गुहावार of the १७थ् द्वापर;
1: वा. २३. १७७.
a मन्त्रकृत् of the आङ्गिरस branch.
2: वा. ५९. ९०-101.
(V)--the eldest brother of बृहस्पति; wife ममता; son, दीर्घतमस्. Vi. IV. १९. १६.

(I)--a favourite son of Suruci and उत्तानपाद. Was embraced by Dhruva after his return from तपस्। It was predicted that he would be killed by an यक्ष in a hunt- ing expedition, and that his mother going in search of him would die by falling into a forest fire. So it happened. भा. IV. 8. 9 & १९; 9. २३ & ४८; १०. 3; Vi. I. ११. 2.

(II)--a son of Priyavrata, and a मन्वन्तर- अधिपति। He was Manu, the third. His sons were Pavana and others. In his epoch Pramada and other sons of वसिष्ठ were the seven sages. The gods were Satyas, वेदश्रुतस् and Bhadras. Satyajit was Indra.
1: भा. V. 1. २८; VIII. 1. २३-24; Vi. III. 1. 6, २४.
According to ब्र्। प्। सुशान्ति was Indra; served as calf to milk the earth in that epoch.
2: Br. II. ३६. 3 & २५, ३७ & ४१; ३७. १६; Vi. III. 1. १३-15.
[page१-216+ २२]
(III)--one of the seven hills of शाल्मलिद्वीप. Br. II. १९. ३६.
(IV)--the twenty-first वेदव्यास. Br. II. ३५. १२२.
(V)--a भार्गव, and a sage of the चाक्षुष epoch. Br. II. ३६. ७७.
(VI)--the father of Satyas. वा. ६७. ३६.
(VII)--a sage of the चाक्षुष epoch. Vi. III. 1. २८.
--a मरीचि god. Br. IV. 1. ५९.
--surname of Hari. भा. X. 1. 4; XII. 3. १५.
--the presiding deity पक्षिराज. वा. ८६. ६२.
(I)--stationed by जरासन्ध at the western gate of मथुरा. भा. X. ५०. ११[5].
(II)--a son of Manu सावर्न II. Br. IV. 1. ७१. [page१-217+ २९]
(III)--a son of ब्रह्मसावर्णि. Vi. III. 2. २८.
--the father of इरावति and father-in-law of परीक्षित्. भा. I. १६. 2.
--a Pravara--sage. M. १९९. १७.
(I)--the name of an asterism. वा. ८२. 7. [page१-219+ २९]

(II)--the daughter of Matsya king विराट, and queen of Abhimanyu. Mother of परीक्षित्.
1: वा. ९९. २४९; भा. I. १०. 9-१०; IX. २२. ३३; III. 3. १७.
अश्वथाम wanted to destroy the child in her womb, and sent out flaming arrows. Pursued by them, उत्तरा invoked कृष्ण's help, who protected her by his सुदर्शन to ensure the continuity of the Kuru line.
2: Ib. I. 8. 8-१५; १२. 1; III. 3. १७;
One among the party that welcomed Vidura.
3: Ib. I. १३. 4; Vi. IV. २०. ५१-2.
--A tribe of the Vindhya regions. वा. ४५. १३२.

--traversed by the river भद्रा; a conti- nent adjoining Meru, in the hill of सुपर्श्व north of शृन्ग- vat and south of the sea. Here Hari revealed himself as वराह (मत्स्य, वि।) and mother Earth praised him by Upa- निषद् naming him यज्ञ and क्रतु।
1: भा. V. १७. 8; १८. ३४, ३९; Br. II. १५. ५१, ७१-80; वा. ३४. ५७; ३५. ४४, ४७; ४१. ८५, ४२. ७७; ४९. १२०; Vi. II. 2, १४, ३८, ५०.
Conquered by परीक्- षित्.
2: भा. I. १६. १३.
Full of milk trees; women-folk excel apsaras; people are born in pair (मिथुन) and love each other as चक्रवाक birds. Here Aila lived for some time with उर्वशी.
3: Br. II. १९. १२४; III. ५९. ४६; ६६. 7; M. ८३. ३४; १०५. २०; ११३. ४४; १२३. २५; वा. ९१. 7.
A sacred तीर्थ।
4: M. १३. ५०.
--the kingdom of Lava. वा. ८८. २००.
--मूर्छना deity, Vasus. वा. ८६. ६६. [page१-218+ २३]
--the kingdom to which पुरञ्जन went through the entrance देवहू; allegorically निवृत्तिशास्त्र। भा. IV. २५. ५१; २९. १३.
--the road to Heaven; also उत्तरापथ; also उत्तरमार्ग consisting of नागवीथि, गजवीथि, and ऐरावतीवीथि। Br. II. २७. १२४; ३५. ११२; III. 3. ४९.
--a loud but slow manner of singing; the presiding deity of this is Dhruva. वा. ८६. ४०, ५६.
--the kingdom of हरिण्मान्. वा. ३३. ४३.
--a sacred lake. M. १२१. ६९. वा. १११. 4.
--the lake beyond मानस; worship सूर्य god. M. १२१. ६९; वा. १११. 4.
--see उत्तरपन्था। Br. III. 3. ४९.
--a goddess following रेवती. M. १७९. ७२.

--the country, north of the Vindhyas; had कारूषस् as kings;
1: भा. IX. 2. १६; Br. III. ६३. १०; वा. ८८. १०.
in charge of ५० sons of ईक्ष्वाकु begin- ning with शकुनि.
2: Vi. IV. 2. १३; Br. III. ६३. ९०; वा. ८८. 9.

--when moon is there the sun becomes नीच; commences with तप or the month of माशि;
1: वा. ५०. १३५ and २०.; ५१. ७२; ५३. ७४; ६१. १०१.
auspicious for death.
2: भा. I. 9. २९.
--the sun at गया. वा. १०९. २१.
--an asterism. वा. ८२. ११.
--The name of the Lord enshrined and wor- shipped by the बाडवस्. वा. ६०. ७१. [page१-220+ ३३]

(I)--son of स्वायम्भुव Manu and शत- रूपा: Brother Priyavrata. Father of Dhruva,
1: भा. III. १२. ५५; १४. 5; २१. 2; IV. 1. 9. Br. I. 1. ५७; II. 9. ४१; २९. ६३; ३०. ३९; M. 4. ३४; १४३. ३८; वा. I. ६६, १२३; १०. १६; ५२. ९२; ५७. ५७; १०४. १२२.
a devotee of Hari. अम्श of वासुदेव.
2: भा. IV. 8. 7.
Had two queens सुनीति and Suruci. The former's son was Dhruva, and the latter's Uttama. Suruci and her son were more beloved of the king. Once when Dhruva ascended his father's lap, Suruci scolded him and asked him to propitiate god to be born of her. Heard that his child of five had gone to the forest with his mother, from नारद, and regretted his action. Was assured by the sage that he would return with glory to his line.
3: भा. IV. 8. 8-१३, ६५-69. M. १२५. 5; १२७. २२. वा. ५१. 6.
Obliged to Hari.
4: भा. IV. २१. २८; ३१. २६; V. १७. 2.
(II)--a son of Atri in the चाक्षुष Manu line; wife सूनृता, a daughter of Dharma. Had four sons and two daughters. Br. II. ३६. ८४-90; वा. ६२. ७२.
--a son of शर्याति. भा. IX. 3. २७.
--is कृष्ण. Br. III. ३६. २८.
